about: Hand-made FPS stream: lobby chatter, a 1v3 clutch that needs its setup, a brb break, a running-gag fail.

segments.text: Alright chat, we are back in the lobby.
Remember to follow if you are new here.
Okay, ranked match, let's lock in.
I'm taking the long route to the bomb site.
There's two of them on the balcony.
No way, my whole team just died.
It is me against three, with forty health.
And I have one bullet left in this pistol.
Okay, okay, okay, stay calm.
One down! He didn't even see me!
Two! Where is the last guy?
He's planting, he's planting!
Knife him, knife him, LET'S GO!
I just won a one versus three with one bullet!
Chat is going crazy right now.
Okay, I need some water after that.
Brb, grabbing a drink.
Back. Where were we?
Let's queue up again.
This next map is the one I always lose on.
Watch, I bet I fall off the map again.
Wait, wait, that jump is impossible.
And there I go, falling off the map. Again.
Every single time, this map hates me.
Alright, chat, that's it for today.

good.why: team dies, one bullet, LET'S GO
